title: UX Sitemap Compiler
description: Validates a product sitemap: every screen has a unique ID, a valid route, a properly formed DAG of parent references, declared visibility for auth-gated screens, and a 404 node. Produces sitemap-artifact.json as the canonical screen inventory for all downstream UX compilers.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract sitemap-spec.json from product scope, route inventory, and role definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate node structure: required fields, unique IDs, valid routes

pipeline.title: Graph Integrity
pipeline.description: Validate parent-child relationships and DAG property

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate visibility, root node count, and 404 declaration

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: sitemap-spec.json exists with nodes array; each node has id, label, route

gates.title: Unique Node IDs
gates.description: All node ids are unique within the sitemap

gates.title: Route Format
gates.description: All non-planned routes start with / and use valid URL path characters

gates.title: No Orphan Nodes
gates.description: Every non-root node's parent id exists in the node list

gates.title: No Circular Parent References
gates.description: Following parent chains from any node never produces a cycle

gates.title: Valid Visibility Values
gates.description: Declared visibility values are: public, authenticated, or a non-empty role string

gates.title: Root Node Limit
gates.description: Root-level nodes do not exceed maxRootNodes (default: 10)

gates.title: 404 Screen Declared
gates.description: At least one node represents the 404/not-found screen, or notFoundHandledExternally=true

gates.title: Sitemap Contract
gates.description: Validates against full sitemap contract: version declared, auth-visibility alignment, no duplicate routes

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled UX sitemaps

error_codes.USM001: sitemap-spec.json missing or invalid — nodes array required with id, label, route per node
error_codes.USM002: Duplicate node id detected — all node ids must be unique within the sitemap
error_codes.USM003: Orphan node — parent id references a node that does not exist in the sitemap
error_codes.USM004: Circular parent reference — following parent chain produces a cycle
error_codes.USM005: Invalid visibility value — must be 'public', 'authenticated', or a non-empty role string
error_codes.USM006: Invalid route format — route must start with '/' and use valid URL path characters
error_codes.USM007: Root node count exceeds limit — too many top-level screens indicates flat IA
error_codes.USM009: Sitemap contract violation — version missing, auth-visibility mismatch, or duplicate routes
